rationale: Standard Coptic ⲣⲱϣⲉ 'be enough, suffice.' Used here in 'one alone sufficed for them' — the Living Fire's single garment was enough against the Enemy.
From ⲟⲩⲱⲥⲉ 'spread out, become wide' (Crum) substantivized as 'breadth, expanse.' Used here of the Enemy's outspread cosmic territory.
Greek loanword φλυαρία 'idle/empty talk, nonsense.' Paired here with ⲙⲛⲧⲭⲁⲥⲓⲍⲏⲧ 'arrogance' as the Enemy's two characteristic vices.
Compound of ⲣ̄- (verbal prefix) + ϩⲱⲃ ('work'). Lycopolitan spelling ⲣ̄ⲟⲱⲃ̄ shows ϩ→zero and intervocalic vowel-doubling. Standard Coptic for 'work, operate, take effect.'
ⲥⲉⲡⲉ (= ⲥⲱϫⲡ̄/ⲥⲉⲉⲡⲉ 'remain') + ⲁⲡⲁⲍⲟⲩ ('backward, behind'). Stative-locative idiom for 'be left over, remain behind.' Used here of the air-garment that was left exposed.
Already in vocab as ⲕⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲏⲩ 'strip naked.' The construction with ⲛ̄- + object specifies what one is stripped of: 'stripped naked of a garment and a power.'
